name: Greece
overview: Scripture reveals that Greece and its inhabitants, often called Gentiles or Greeks, held a significant place in biblical history and prophecy. The Greeks are depicted as both seekers of Jesus, as seen when certain Greeks came to worship (John 12:20), and as persecutors of early Christians (Acts 6:9). Prophecies also speak of conflicts involving Greece (Daniel 10:20; Zechariah 9:13), highlighting their role in God's sovereign plan. Additionally, the New Testament shows Greeks interacting with Jewish believers, desiring to accept the Messiah and sometimes marrying among the Jews (Mark 7:26; John 7:35).
